{{Top|leg}}
'''Servo remote mode''' was the process by which [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] could control the [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] from the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] rather than independent control. The system made use of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer]].<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
